sentences.en: WOMAN: Hello, Oyster Bay Sailing Club
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你好，牡蛎湾帆船俱乐部。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮您什么忙吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Oh hi
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，你好。

sentences.en: I'd like to find out about sailing courses for beginners
sentences.zh: 我想了解一下针对初学者的帆船课程。

sentences.en: WOMAN: No problem
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没问题。

sentences.en: Is it for yourself?
sentences.zh: 这是为您本人报名的吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的。

sentences.en: I had a look online but I'm not sure which course would be best
sentences.zh: 我之前在网上查过，但不太确定哪门课程最适合我。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Well you might be interested in our Taster Days?
sentences.zh: 嗯，您可能对我们的‘体验日’课程感兴趣？

sentences.en: MAN: Possibly
sentences.zh: MAN: 有可能。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So these are for people who've never sailed before – it's basically an introduction to sailing to find out whether you enjoy it and want to carry on with it
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这些课程面向从未接触过帆船的人——本质上是帆船入门介绍，旨在帮助您了解自己是否喜欢这项运动，并决定是否继续深入学习。

sentences.en: MAN: And how much is that?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那费用是多少？

sentences.en: WOMAN: It's £120 for the day - but it's reduced to £110 each if there are two of you
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 一天课程收费120英镑——但如果两人一同报名，则每人只需110英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: No, it would just be me
sentences.zh: MAN: 不，就我一个人。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh that's fine
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，没问题。

sentences.en: You'd be in a small group, usually about eight people but no more than ten – and everyone's always very friendly
sentences.zh: 您将加入一个小班，通常约八人，最多不超过十人——而且大家总是非常友好。

sentences.en: MAN: Uh huh
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: And are there any other suitable courses?
sentences.zh: 还有其他合适的课程吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: The other option is the Level 1 course
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 另一个选择是1级课程。

sentences.en: These are two-day weekend courses and we run those all year round
sentences.zh: 这些是为期两天的周末课程，我们全年都开设。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And what do you learn on that course?
sentences.zh: 那么，你在该课程中会学到什么？

sentences.en: WOMAN: This is a mix of theory and practical skills
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这门课程理论与实践技能相结合。

sentences.en: So you learn about things like the weather, which is obviously really important and also the tides, as well as learning basic sailing skills
sentences.zh: 因此，你将学习诸如天气（这显然非常重要）以及潮汐等知识，同时还会掌握基础的帆船驾驶技能。

sentences.en: You go out into the harbour in special training dinghies for beginners, two people in each dinghy and an instructor
sentences.zh: 你们将乘坐专为初学者设计的训练小艇出海进入港口，每艘小艇两人，并配备一名教练。

sentences.en: He or she will make sure you understand everything you need to know about safety
sentences.zh: 这位教练会确保你充分理解所有必要的安全知识。

sentences.en: MAN: It sounds like hard work!
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来挺辛苦的！

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, but you'll have a lot of fun too
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，但你也会玩得很开心。

sentences.en: MAN: And the cost of that one is... ?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那这门课程的费用是……？

sentences.en: But it's a bit cheaper if you decide to join the club
sentences.zh: 不过，如果你决定加入俱乐部，费用会略低一些。

sentences.en: There's a discount for members
sentences.zh: 会员可享受折扣。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, I'm not sure about that yet
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我目前还不确定是否要加入。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You've got plenty of time to decide
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你还有充足的时间来决定。

sentences.en: MAN: And does the cost include everything?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那费用是否包含所有项目？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, everything's included and you also get a really good dictionary explaining all the sailing terminology
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，所有费用均已包含在内；此外，你还将获得一本非常实用的词典，其中详细解释了所有帆船术语。

sentences.en: A lot of people struggle with this at first
sentences.zh: 很多人刚开始时对这些术语感到困难。

sentences.en: It's got lots of pictures, so I'm sure you'd find it really helpful
sentences.zh: 这本词典配有大量插图，我相信你会觉得它非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And on completion of the course you get a certificate
sentences.zh: 课程结束后，你将获得结业证书。

sentences.en: Then you're ready to move on to the Level 2 course
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以进入二级课程了。

sentences.en: MAN: Sounds good
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I think that's all the info you need for now
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我觉得目前你需要的信息就这些了。

sentences.en: Just a couple of general things
sentences.zh: 再简单提几点注意事项。

sentences.en: For example, it's really important that you know how to swim
sentences.zh: 例如，你必须掌握游泳技能，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, I'm pretty confident in the water
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我在水里相当自信。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Great
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太好了。

sentences.en: The other thing I should tell you is that we provide wetsuits and life jackets but you need to bring swimming trunks and some old trainers
sentences.zh: 另外我要提醒你的是，我们会提供潜水服和救生衣，但你需要自备泳裤和一双旧运动鞋。

sentences.en: MAN: And a towel?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那毛巾呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes definitely
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，一定要带。

sentences.en: And you might want to bring your own toiletries, things like shampoo
sentences.zh: 你可能还想自带洗漱用品，比如洗发水之类的。

sentences.en: MAN: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: What about food and drink?
sentences.zh: 那食物和饮料呢？

sentences.en: Do I need to bring that or is there a café at the club?
sentences.zh: 我需要自己带，还是俱乐部里有咖啡馆？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, you can get sandwiches, cakes and snacks there
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 有的，那里可以买到三明治、蛋糕和零食。

sentences.en: The food's pretty reasonable
sentences.zh: 食物价格相当合理。

sentences.en: MAN: OK good
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，不错。

sentences.en: Well I think I'm interested in the Level 1 course
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对一级课程很感兴趣。

sentences.en: But I know absolutely nothing about sailing so is there anything I can do to prepare myself a bit?
sentences.zh: 但我对帆船运动一无所知，那么有没有什么我可以提前做的准备呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: I recommend you watch some videos we use for training
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我建议你观看我们培训时使用的一些视频。

sentences.en: They're available online
sentences.zh: 它们可以在网上获取。

sentences.en: I can send you the link
sentences.zh: 我可以把链接发给你。

sentences.en: They'll give you an idea of what to expect
sentences.zh: 它们会帮你了解自己可以期待什么。

sentences.en: MAN: Perfect, thanks
sentences.zh: 男士：太好了，谢谢。

sentences.en: That would be very helpful
sentences.zh: 那将非常有帮助。

sentences.en: Oh and just one other thing - I'll be cycling to the club and will need somewhere to put valuables
sentences.zh: 哦，还有一件事——我将骑自行车去俱乐部，需要一个地方存放贵重物品。

sentences.en: I'm just wondering if there are lockers for people to use?
sentences.zh: 我想知道是否有供人们使用的储物柜？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, there are plenty in the changing rooms
sentences.zh: 女士：是的，更衣室里有很多。

sentences.en: MAN: Great
sentences.zh: 男士：太好了。

sentences.en: OK well could you book me onto
sentences.zh: 好的，那么你能帮我报名参加……
